warnings: As of early 2024, many U.S. state and local COVID-19 dashboards had reduced reporting frequency or granularity; weekly incident data for 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-07 may require aggregation from multiple sub-weekly reports or may only be available as a weekly summary.
New York State and New York City maintain separate reporting systems; both must be queried independently to achieve full geographic coverage, and double-counting must be avoided when combining.
CDC transitioned COVID-19 data reporting in 2023–2024; verify which CDC datasets remain active and cover the target time window.
source_discovery_not_yet_disease_generic: Source discovery tooling is not yet fully generalized; manual source identification for NYSDOH and NYC DOHMH dashboards may be required.
extraction_record_model_still_hantavirus_named: The extraction record model retains a legacy disease-specific name; ensure extracted records are mapped to the correct COVID-19 schema fields.
Evidence quotes must be verbatim excerpts from the source; do not paraphrase or synthesize across sources for the evidence_quote field.
If only cumulative counts are available for the target window, record as cases_unspecified with a count_semantics note; do not infer incident counts.
Wastewater and syndromic surveillance signals available for New York should be recorded as supplementary signals, not as primary case counts.
